description: This file defines an abstract class 'FilterField' which is part of the OrangeHRM application, specifically within the reporting filter field components. It includes properties and method signatures for managing filter field parameters and behaviors, and serves as a base class for concrete filter field implementations.

classes.name: FilterField
classes.description: An abstract class for defining filter fields in the reporting module, managing properties like order, coordinates, operator, and requiring subclasses to implement query modification and alias retrieval.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a FilterField with optional operator, coordinates (x, y), and order.

methods.name: addWhereToQueryBuilder
methods.description: Abstract method to add filter conditions to a query builder.

methods.name: getEntityAliases
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve entity aliases used in this filter.

methods.name: getOrder
methods.description: Returns the order index of the filter field.

methods.name: getX
methods.description: Returns the X coordinate or null.

methods.name: getY
methods.description: Returns the Y coordinate or null.

methods.name: getOperator
methods.description: Returns the operator string or null.

methods.name: modifyX
methods.description: Applies a callable to modify the value of x.

methods.name: modifyY
methods.description: Applies a callable to modify the value of y.
